entries.value:
for f in "$P"/* "$P"/.[!.]* "$P"/..?*; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || [ -L "$f" ] || continue
  if [ -d "$f" ]; then t=D; elif [ -L "$f" ]; then t=L; else t=F; fi
  s=$(/data/adb/ksu/bin/busybox stat -c '%s' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  m=$(/data/adb/ksu/bin/busybox stat -c '%Y' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  p=$(/data/adb/ksu/bin/busybox stat -c '%A' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo ---------)
  n=$(/data/adb/ksu/bin/busybox basename "$f")
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$t" "$s" "$m" "$p" "$n"
done
